sloka: राक्षसी भ्रातरम् क्रूरम् सा ददर्श महाबलम् ।तम् दिव्य वस्त्र आभरणम् दिव्य माल्य उपशोभितम् ॥३-३२-२२॥
transliteration: rākṣasī bhrātaram krūram sā dadarśa mahābalam ।tam divya vastra ābharaṇam divya mālya upaśobhitam ॥3-32-22॥

translations.english: Resplendently attired, adorned with jewels, wearing beautiful gardlands, seated on a raised throne, he(Ravana) was like death to even the lord of death
